route_note: Take a tro-tro or taxi from Accra's Circle or Kaneshie area toward Aburi (about 1 hour); the botanical gardens are a short local taxi ride from the town centre, and you can return the same way.
see: Mountain views from the hill station
Aburi town centre and craft stalls
Local cafés and fresh fruit stands
tour_query: Aburi Botanical Gardens day trip from Accra

route_note: Take a direct bus or intercity coach from Accra's Kaneshie or Circle terminals to Cape Coast (about 2.5 to 3 hours), then a taxi to the castle and Kakum; plan an early start for the return.
tour_query: Cape Coast Castle and Kakum day trip from Accra

route_note: Take a tro-tro or bus from Accra toward Akosombo (about 2 hours); the dam and lake viewpoints are reached by short taxi ride from the town.
see: Local boat tours on the lake
tour_query: Akosombo Dam and Volta Lake day trip from Accra
